hypothesis: Pipeline parity check after square-indexing fix. Train 100k-row slice from lc0q10m.bullet, export, verify engine loads and evaluates sensibly (not -600 Elo). This is NOT a candidate; it's proof the fixed spike_trainer works.

changed_variables.training: Bullet spike_trainer with square ^ 63 fix, 1 epoch, baseline params

stages.name: build_spike_trainer
stages.why: Rebuild spike_trainer with CUDA and the square ^ 63 fix from main

stages.name: train
stages.why: Train 100k rows for 64 superbatches (~1 epoch equivalent). Small enough for fast iteration, large enough to produce coherent features.

stages.name: export_verify
stages.why: Verify .nn was exported and copy to assets for testing

stages.name: engine_load_test
stages.command:
echo 'uci
setoption name nnue_file value ~/assets/nets/native-8.0.0-rc0-parity.nn
isready
position fen r1bqkb1r/pppp1ppp/2n2n2/4p3/2B1P3/5N2/PPPP1PPP/RNBQK2R w KQkq - 4 4
evalnet
quit' | ~/assets/engines/enyo_8bae476
stages.why: Load the net in hardened engine and eval a test position. Should print 'evalnet <score> cp' without errors. Score should be reasonable (-500 to +500 range, not wildly broken).

gates: spike_trainer builds successfully with cuda feature
training completes and produces quantised.bin at expected path
engine loads the .nn without error (hardened engine would fail on bad path/format)
evalnet produces a score in reasonable range (parity gate: if score looks sane, indexing is correct)
if this passes, iteration 1 (native-8.0.0-rc1 on full 10M lc0q10m) is cleared to start
